promise: Apple's commitment to invest $600 billion in the U.S. economy over four years
description: At the White House on August 6, 2025, Cook joined President Trump to raise Apple's U.S. investment commitment from $500 billion to $600 billion over four years, including plans to directly hire 20,000 people and the new American Manufacturing Program. Apple reaffirmed the pledge in July 2026 when announcing its Broadcom agreement.
evidence: Apple Newsroom, July 2026: Broadcom deal is part of the $600 billion four-year U.S. commitment
